items.quote: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
items.claim: Moses expressed to God his concern about his speech difficulty and doubt that Pharaoh would listen to him

items.quote: See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh
items.claim: The LORD appointed Moses as a god to Pharaoh

items.quote: Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet
items.claim: Aaron was designated to serve as Moses's prophet
